title: Lists and syntax inside Peano arithmetic

based_on.title: Provability logic: models within models in Peano Arithmetic
An Introduction to Gödel's Theorems, second edition, corrected Logic Matters reprint

summary: Concrete list traversals and syntax routines retain their equations at nonstandard codes.
abstract: A proof checker manipulates lists, formula codes and substitutions. Ordinary numerical correctness is not enough when the checker is itself studied inside arithmetic: the same routines must satisfy their equations at every internal code. We build the list operations from an explicit bounded traversal, then use a table of earlier answers to recognize and rewrite syntax. Each proof states the invariant that connects the implemented loop to its intended operation. The resulting substitution and freshness theorems explain why the later proof constructions remain valid even in nonstandard models.
